title: Bound or parallelize project-wide Engram MCP revocation teardown
outcome: Immediate grant clear, Engram disable, and project deletion atomically capture the affected runtime batch, then synchronously checkpoint and stop each session one by one. Each dedicated target can consume a project control deadline plus two bounded shutdown attempts, so request latency grows with every parent/delegation descendant and can appear hung. Preserve atomic fencing while capping total request wall time or running independent target teardown concurrently; add a multi-session deadline regression and document the API bound. Found as a Low performance issue in the fourth tm-uw7j delegated review.
